records_tissue.notes: Value = a3, the fitted value at time zero (before fixation). Table 1 gives fit parameters of y = a1(1 - exp(-a2 t)) + a3 for 4 ROIs; column groups are a3 (value at time zero), a1 + a3 (asymptotic value) and 5/a2 (h). This record uses ROI 4 (the deepest, approximately 14 mm from the cortical surface), mean of 3 brains; the paper uses ROI 4 for its summary in the body text. ROI 1 to 3 (2, 6, 10 mm deep) are not recorded. No error value is given. PD is given in grayscale units only and is not recorded. Scans were made at about 20 time points from 0 h to 514-518 h; only the fitted start value and the fitted asymptote are recorded. The authors say that the TR values were not optimal for T1 and that a small random bias from the receiver gain is possible.
